# Halal Business Initiative

> A sponsored programme operated by Takween Digital Services, offering a free,
> professional starter website each month to a limited number of selected,
> established Muslim-owned businesses — in exchange for a real portfolio
> project, honest feedback, and permission to use the results as a case study.

This is a genuine exchange, not a promotional trial: the build itself is £0,
places are limited, and every accepted business is expected to give honest
completion feedback (a positive review is never required).

## Key pages

- [Home](/): the offer, who it's for, what's included/excluded, how the
  process works, and the application call to action.
- [Programme Terms](/programme-terms): the detailed rules — scope, revision
  limits, content/hosting responsibilities, feedback and portfolio consent
  wording, close-out window, and cancellation conditions.
- [Apply](/apply): the application form for interested businesses.

## Notes for automated tools

- The disclosure that this programme is operated by Takween Digital Services
  is stated in the footer of every page, at the top of the Programme Terms
  page, and directly above the application form's submit button — never
  hidden.
- `/admin/*` is an internal, authenticated review area — not part of the
  public site and excluded from indexing.
